summary: Remove the legacy missions publish and agents apply commands; publish KDL with fractal apply

replay.detail: Historical publications retain their existing representation and replay behavior.

schema.detail: No database or KDL schema change.

compatibility.detail: The CLI no longer accepts missions publish or agents apply. The canonical apply command and owned-set publication are unchanged.

downtime.detail: No service restart or interruption is required.

manual.detail: Replace missions publish FILE with fractal apply FILE using the same options; replace agents apply FILE with fractal apply FILE --no-gate-check.

recovery.detail: No durable-state mutation or new recovery procedure.
